instructions: Use codes only when justified by observed evidence; use an inconclusive outcome when evidence is insufficient (tentative ranked hypotheses may remain). These are benchmark labels, not per-incident answers. Explain each selected code in the report or finding statement.

definitions.mechanism_observation: A current observed fact identifying the proposed failure mechanism. Cite its exact canonical record.
definitions.controlled_comparison: A discriminating changed-variable comparison. Cite BOTH original and corrected controlled observations.
definitions.tenant_impact: Observed scope and severity. Cite metrics for BOTH the affected tenant and comparison tenant.
definitions.telemetry_gap: An explicit observation establishing missing causal telemetry; do not infer absence from an empty partial query.
definitions.notion_resource_not_shared_remediation: Share only the intended page with the existing Notion integration and verify access; do not widen unrelated permissions.
definitions.trigger_event_kind_mismatch_remediation: Select the current trigger for the intended update event and verify a new edit; preserve the existing connection.
definitions.github_organization_approval_remediation: Request approval from the GitHub organization owner for the intended OAuth app, then retest the organization resource.
definitions.redacted_token_relay_design_remediation: Route the provider request through authenticated tool/proxy execution rather than extracting a provider token.
definitions.obsolete_trigger_setup_path_remediation: Create/upsert the V2 trigger directly through the supported trigger-instance path and verify a new event.
definitions.connection_surface_isolation_remediation: Connect Sheets through the MCP authentication flow used by this client; do not assume Platform connections are shared.
definitions.tool_discovery_truncation_remediation: Paginate or raise the discovery limit, then execute the exact returned action slug on the intended version.
definitions.spreadsheet_identifier_kind_remediation: Pass the intended spreadsheet ID, then verify the target and requested range before writing.
definitions.authentication_initiation_expired_remedi: Start a fresh authentication initiation and complete it within its valid window; avoid retrying the expired link.
definitions.provider_batch_record_limit_remediation: Split updates into batches of at most ten records, respect provider rate limits, and verify partial completion before retrying.
definitions.slack_user_scope_configuration_remediati: Configure the needed user_scopes and reconnect the intended user; bot scopes do not authorize user-token actions.
definitions.provider_feature_entitlement_remediation: Check workspace eligibility and feature enablement; use a supported search alternative or obtain the required plan before retesting.
definitions.provider_event_ingress_misrouting_remedi: Restore the intended Slack app event-subscription ingress and verify a newly generated message before considering replay.
definitions.oauth_redirect_uri_mismatch_remediation: Match the OAuth app redirect setting to the auth config callback URI; keep the short per-connection link separate.
definitions.attachment_reference_shape_remediation: Upload the file and pass the supported file object, then validate the serialized attachment argument before sending.
definitions.temporary_file_reference_expired_remedia: Upload a fresh file shortly before execution and use its current reference; verify send status before any retry.
definitions.session_tool_policy_block_remediation: Keep least privilege: use an explicitly authorized narrow tool exception only if the workflow should write, then verify the effective policy.
definitions.webhook_receiver_not_idempotent_remediat: Deduplicate receiver processing using a stable event/log identifier and verify retry behavior without assuming duplicate provider ingress.
definitions.scheduled_attachment_semantics_remediati: Upload the file separately and include its supported link in the scheduled message body, then verify the scheduled result.
